_comment: Section VIII Mandatory Components, Illinois 2027-2028 QAP (PDF pp.27-39). One row per lettered component; P is split into its three sub-requirements. The PPA-stage requirements of Section VI (including food access and financial feasibility criteria at PPA) and the external guides the components incorporate (DCRC, Underwriting Standards Guide, market study standards, PSH Requirements Guide) are not itemised.

criteria.quote: The Application must include a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment

criteria.heading: Design, Construction & Regulatory Compliance Requirements
criteria.quote: All Projects must meet the requirements contained in the Authority

criteria.heading: Construction Cost Breakdown

criteria.quote: the Application must demonstrate that the Project will not cause permanent displacement and must include a relocation plan

criteria.heading: Market Study
criteria.quote: The Application must include a Site and Market Study completed according to the Authority

criteria.heading: Development Team

criteria.heading: Financial Feasibility
criteria.quote: In order to demonstrate financial feasibility, Projects must be consistent with requirements detailed in the Authority

criteria.quote: must adhere to the 2026 Enterprise Green Communities mandatory project criteria in the eight major sections of the EGC

criteria.heading: Statewide Referral Network units
criteria.quote: All Projects pursuing 4% Tax Credits in any geographic Set-Aside must dedicate 5% of total affordable units to the SRN

criteria.heading: Veterans Housing Preference
criteria.quote: Projects must exercise a waitlist preference for veterans for a minimum of 10% of the development

criteria.quote: Projects must agree to accepting Section 811 Project Rental Assistance

criteria.heading: Qualified Contract Waiver
criteria.quote: all Sponsors will be required to waive their right to seek a Qualified Contract.

criteria.heading: Application Certification, Organizational Chart, and Identity of Interest Certification
criteria.quote: Sponsors must submit a completed Application Certification, Organizational Chart, and Identity of Interest Certification.
